# EmptyState

## EmptyState family

A title, supporting text, an action and a link under an optional
illustration. The upstream is the product-patterns `EmptyState`.

### Decisions

The action is an `sm` `tertiary` Button (the upstream default); the title
is a `Heading`-sized text in the `empty_state_title` type sets; the
illustration is a host `Image` (or a node) seated at `top` or `left`.

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`.

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `object` | no | The action button `{ text, onClick, kind }` - `tertiary` `sm` by default. |
| `illustration` | `node` | no | The illustration (Image or node). |
| `illustrationPosition` | `string` | no | One of `top`, `left`. Default `top`. |
| `link` | `object` | no | The learn-more link `{ text, href }`. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `lg`, `sm`. Default `lg`. |
| `subtitle` | `string` | no | The supporting text under the title. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |
| `title` | `string` | yes | The title. |
